requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The bachelor's degree requires a minimum of 120 credits, including the prerequisite courses completed before entering the school.

requirements.label: Upper-level credits (60)
requirements.hint: At least 60 of the 120 credits must be upper level. Any 300-level or higher course at U-M counts, as do the published 200-level pre-health exceptions (select BIOLOGY, CHEM, PHYSICS, PHYSIOL, and NURS courses) and the final course of a fourth-term language sequence.

requirements.label: Upper-level SPH credits (45)
requirements.hint: 45 of the 60 upper-level credits must come from School of Public Health courses (PUBHLTH, BIOSTAT, EHS, EPID, HBHEQ, HMP, NUTR). The remaining 15 may be any upper-level U-M coursework.

requirements.label: PUBHLTH 200: Health and Society
requirements.hint: Admission prerequisite, completed before entering the school. Prerequisites must be taken for a letter grade (C- or better, no pass/fail) and AP credit does not fulfill them.

requirements.label: Statistics (STATS 250)
requirements.hint: STATS 250 or an approved alternative: DATASCI 101, STATS 206, or STATS 280. Admission prerequisite; letter grade of C- or better, no pass/fail, no AP credit.

requirements.label: First-year writing prerequisite
requirements.hint: One course fulfilling the First-Year Writing Requirement, completed before entering the school with a C- or better.

requirements.label: Social science prerequisite (3 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 3 credits in anthropology, communications, economics, history, international studies, political science, psychology, sociology, or women's studies. Prerequisite courses may not double count toward another prerequisite.

requirements.label: Humanities or Creative Expression prerequisite
requirements.hint: At least 3 credits in either the humanities or creative expression.

requirements.label: Life science prerequisite (3 credits)
requirements.hint: At least 3 credits of life science; chemistry and physics do not count. Matched by life-science department (ANATOMY, BIOLOGY, EEB, MCDB, MICRBIOL, PHYSIOL); use the adjust control for a qualifying course from another department.

requirements.label: Integrated core (PUBHLTH 381, 382, 383, 384)
requirements.hint: The four-course integrated core taken by all public health majors across the junior and senior years: Public Health Systems, Population Health Determinants & Disparities, Data Driven Solutions, and Creating Change in Public Health.

requirements.label: PUBHLTH 350: Global Public Health
requirements.hint: Required for the BA in Community and Global Public Health.

requirements.label: PUBHLTH 360: Community, Culture & Social Justice
requirements.hint: Required for the BA in Community and Global Public Health. Also on the approved health equity list, so it satisfies both rows.

requirements.label: Health equity course (3 credits)
requirements.hint: One approved 3-credit health equity course: PUBHLTH 308, 313, 320, 328, 360, or 450. The approved PUBHLTH 333 topic section (Power and Politics of Public Health) also counts; force it in with the adjust control since topic sections aren't tracked.

requirements.label: Public health electives (18 credits)
requirements.hint: 18 credits of public health coursework at the 300 level or above, outside this degree's required courses. Courses required by the BS (such as PUBHLTH 370) and graduate SPH courses open to undergraduates count.

requirements.label: Culminating experience (PUBHLTH 380 & 481)
requirements.hint: Public Health Leadership (1 credit, junior year) and Public Health Practice & Professionalism (3 credits, senior fall).
